description: `between` requires the value and both bounds to be all-number or all-word; mixing a number value with a word low-bound raises `ol-type` naming the mismatched bound's concept "number" (spec/execution-model.md:146-166, error-model.md `ol-type`). The check finds nothing here, so Phase 2 begins and execution halts at the failing statement, keeping the `instruction` event asserted below — the fault is genuinely runtime, not check-caught. Issue #99. Issue #1156 corrected this description, which used to deny that this statement executed at all — contradicting the event asserted below. That sentence was pasted from `core-language/execution/is-a-unknown-type`, the check-caught worded-form fixture, where both of its clauses are measured true.
